Q6113.reason: Common-law arson requires malice (intent or recklessness); inadvertently leaving the stove on is mere negligence, and failure to commit some other felony is not the reason for acquittal.

Q9000.reason: GA resolutions are not binding formal sources and do not always codify custom; they are material sources that may enunciate or evidence customary law.

Q9002.reason: “Provided that if… may re-enter” is condition-subsequent language plus an express right of entry, so the estate does not end automatically.
